observation_input_variables: spatial or feature-based attention applied to the higher layer
internal_representations: two reciprocally connected orientation-selective visual maps
transformation_update_operators: modulatory backprojection proportional to feedforward weights
temporal_order: bottom input -> higher-layer feedforward drive -> higher-layer attentional modulation -> modulatory feedback -> recomputation/settling
the ordering is computational; fine biological timing is not claimed
learning_update_rules: no central cognitive learning rule; parameters/connectivity are fixed across modeled experiments after calibration
decision_readout_rules: modeled firing rates and receptive-field effects are direct outputs; no separate behavioral decision controller
constraints: feedback is modulatory rather than independently driving
higher-layer receptive-field scale exceeds lower-layer scale
gating_selection_operations: spatial/feature attention multiplicatively modulates selected higher-layer cells
explicitly_modeled_interfaces: input: image drive plus externally supplied attention field
system_world_boundary_assumptions: the origin of top-down attention is outside/unspecified by the modeled two-layer circuit
negative_adverse_findings: fine temporal dynamics, synchrony/noise correlations and late-phase effects omitted
common +20% parameter perturbation can eliminate many modeled effects
unresolved_source_ambiguity: upstream source of the attention signal is deliberately unspecified
